messages:
lina_csm: Quick ask — can we make a customer-friendly 1-pager 'health thermometer' for onboarding and renewal reviews? Needs onboarding status, simple renewal signals, and three short ops tips about caching/batching/streaming.

maria_cs: Yes. Suggested fields: stage (0-5), key flows, weekly_active, avg_latency_ms, error_rate_24h, warm_pool (ok/warm/cold), cache_hit_pct, renewal_risk (green/yellow/red) + 1-line note.

aj_devex: Customer tips (short):
- Turn on prefix caching to lower latency and token use.
- Use client batch_size=8 for balanced latency/cost.
- Prefer streaming for long outputs; stop early on matches.
Snippet: `client.config({batch_size:8, streaming:true, caching:'prefill'})`

sam_sre: Ops addendum (private): Dedicated can use batch_size up to 16; check `infractl warmpool status`. Triage steps: p95 latency -> cache hit % -> flip prefill to aggressive -> fallback to single-shot.

ops-bot: Uploaded draft: https://internal.redwood/cs/health-thermometer-draft — please review.

lina_csm: Thanks — I'll assemble v0.1 and run a 3-customer pilot next week. Ping me to join.
